title: The 4 Best Pressure Washers for Small Jobs Around the House
h1: The 4 Best Pressure Washers for Small Jobs Around the House
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for pressure washers for small jobs around the house, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pressure washers for small jobs around the house using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Greenworks GPW1501 1500 PSI Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500 max PSI, 1.2 GPM, Upright hand-carry design, Turbo nozzle included.
strengths: Lightest, most compact unit in this list, easy to carry one-handed to wherever the job is
1500 PSI is well matched to patio furniture, grills, bikes, and similar surfaces without extra caution needed
Small enough to store on a shelf rather than taking up garage floor space
limitations: 1.2 GPM is the slowest flow rate among common household pressure washers, small jobs still finish quickly given their size
Underpowered for driveways, siding, or large decks, this is a dedicated small-jobs tool
Fewer included nozzle options than larger units like the Sun Joe SPX3000

products.name: AR Blue Clean AR383 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1900 PSI, 1.51 GPM, Bayonet-connect accessories, Onboard detergent tank.
strengths: 1900 PSI gives enough headroom to occasionally tackle a walkway or small patio, not just the smallest jobs
Integrated hose reel and onboard storage keep it tidy for infrequent use
Priced low enough that it's an easy first pressure washer purchase
limitations: Bulkier and heavier than the dedicated-compact Greenworks GPW1501
Bayonet fittings limit some aftermarket accessory compatibility
Still not intended for driveway-scale or gas-level cleaning jobs

products.name: Sun Joe SPX3000 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2030 max PSI, 1.76 GPM max flow, 5 quick-connect nozzles, Dual detergent tanks.
strengths: Covers small jobs and larger surfaces like driveways or decks with the same unit, no need for two machines
Widest nozzle selection here, making it easy to dial down pressure for delicate items like screens or planters
Most reviewed model in this category, easy to find support, parts, and accessories
limitations: Larger and heavier than the Greenworks GPW1501 for someone who genuinely only needs light-duty use
Overkill in raw PSI for items like patio cushions or bicycles
Takes up more storage space than a dedicated compact unit
